budget_items.topic: Director's Report: FY23 budget spending pace
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 budget was 53% expended with 66% of the fiscal year elapsed; salaries are on schedule, including two vacant positions, and utilities are expected to rise toward year end.
budget_items.quote: the fy23 budget is 53% expended and we are 66% through the fiscal year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Programs spending stood at 34% of its budget, with more programs expected in spring.
budget_items.quote: programs are only at 34% of the budget but a lot of programs will be coming up in the spring.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Postage ran well over normal because of fine-free and overdue notifications; CWMARS Network expenses increased. No dollar figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: postage expenses have been way over normal due to fine-free/overdue notifications.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Most library requests were funded in the FY24 budget; electricity increases and the copy machine were not funded. The technology request was $18k and $15k was funded, including security camera replacement and $9k for three staff workstations.
budget_items.quote: $18k was requested for the technology budget and $15k was funded.

budget_items.topic: Trust fund transfer to Edward Jones account
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Edward Jones account is to be funded within a week, with approximately $80k to be transferred.
budget_items.quote: the edward jones account should be funded in the next week. approximately $80k will be transferred.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Requests under consideration with the budget subcommittee were HVAC redesign and construction (estimated around $150k) and a backup generator (estimated around $25k), with $50k for the memorial garden and a possible teen room expansion also considered.
budget_items.quote: requests under consideration are the redesign and construction of the hvac system, estimated to be around $150k and a backup generator, estimated to be around $25k.

budget_items.topic: Friends of the Library bequest for garden
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Friends have $20k available from a bequest that could fund garden design and renovation.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Electricity increases were among the library requests not funded in the FY24 budget. No dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: some requests that were not funded included electricity increases and the copy machine.
